qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Specialized engineering know-how and installed base across pulp & paper, hydro, and metals, but structural competitive bidding in large capital projects and cyclic capex exposure cap returns and eliminate real pricing power.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (Rejected – G3 Moat & Pricing). Project-driven plant equipment and EPC contracting across pulp & paper, hydropower, and metals. Low-margin tender competition against Valmet and Voith prevents pricing power >= inflation, resulting in sub-hurdle multi-cycle GAAP ROIC (~9-11%).
qualitative.evidence: Operating margins average 5-8% and GAAP ROIC tracks ~9-11%, failing the 12% hurdle. Large-scale capital projects involve lumpiness, fixed-price risk, and intense customer procurement power, despite aftermarket service expansion.
